ValidationRule.description: DEPRECATED - Cancelled Status can only be used by Sys Admin profile as of now
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( CONTAINS( $Profile.Name , 'System Admin' ) ) , OR( AND( ISNEW(), ISPICKVAL( Status, "Cancelled")), AND( ISCHANGED( Status ), ISPICKVAL( Status, "Cancelled") ), AND( ISCHANGED( Status ), NOT(ISPICKVAL( Status, "Cancelled")) ), AND( ISNEW(), ISPICKVAL( NSP_Status__c, "Cancelled")), AND( ISCHANGED( NSP_Status__c ), ISPICKVAL( NSP_Status__c, "Cancelled") ), AND( ISCHANGED( NSP_Status__c ), NOT(ISPICKVAL( NSP_Status__c, "Cancelled")) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You do not have permission to set the status to "Cancelled" at this time.
